source: Real browser capture of daylight-globe.html with EUMETSAT and NOAA live responses
view: Dusk Earth and camera-relative real solar bearing, with the catalog sky
processing: Canvas-only browser screenshot with controls hidden. Centered crop and resize. Infrared imagery was the available cloud source at capture. Coverage edges fade inside observed pixels. Solar bloom and point exposure are illustrative.
